page.overview:
What is Martha My Dear?

Martha My Dear is the ninth track from The Beatles's ninth album, The Beatles, being a song written by Paul McCartney about his English Sheepdog, Martha.thumb|Paul With Martha

Martha my dear Though I spend my days in conversation Please Remember me Martha, my love Don't forget me Martha my dear

Hold your head up, you silly girl Look what you've done When you find yourself in the thick of it Help yourself to a bit of what's all around you Silly girl

Take a good look around you Take a good look around to see That you and me Were meant to be, for each other Silly girl
